evidence.observation: H701 reads 408.569 °C, markedly above the other heater and vessel temperatures.
T701 has risen to 416.937 °C while T702 is 76.370 °C and the reboiler vessel is 66.612 °C; this discrepancy warrants verification for actual overheating versus a temperature-measurement fault.
System pressure is 450.270 mbar and differential pressures are 0.349 and 2.360 mbar; the observed history does not show a sustained pressure rise corroborating a blockage.
Temperatures have declined to 63.653, 65.115 and 64.556 °C; temperature trends alone do not establish separation composition.

args.missing_evidence: H701 operating setpoint and allowable temperature, heater power/readback, and an independent temperature measurement are needed to distinguish actual overheating from sensor error; product composition and the target specification are needed to assess separation. Distillate, reflux and cooling-water flow sensors are not installed.
